name: How long does a light-commercial restoration project take?
description: Project duration varies; minor damage takes days, extensive damage can take weeks or months, depending on scope, materials, and necessary permits.

mainEntity.name: How long does a light-commercial restoration project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a light-commercial restoration project is highly variable, depending on the scope and complexity of the damage. Minor water damage restoration might take a few days to a week, while extensive fire damage or structural repairs could extend to several weeks or even months. Factors like the drying process, demolition, material lead times, and permitting can influence the timeline. A detailed project schedule will be provided after the initial assessment to set clear expectations.
